text: Coffee with Phoebe. She's 20 weeks now, scan on 14 November. Her husband Dimitri has started painting the nursery. Bridget's throwing her a baby shower, probably early December.

Long catch-up with Oisín after five a side. He's still obsessed with Bohemians, has a season ticket for 2027 already. His sister Aisha is getting married on 3rd of June in Galway. I should send him that Irish football podcast link.
Kemal and Zeynep's little boy arrived Saturday! 3.4kg, called Deniz. Both shattered but fine. Christening pencilled in for March 2027. Must get a card in the post this week.
Fang rang. She's taken up pottery, Thursday evenings at the community centre, and wants to make everyone mugs for Christmas. Her mum's coming over from Chengdu on 2 December for three months.
Hugo's band has a gig at the Lexington on 21/11. He's nervous because it's their first with the new drummer. Don't forget to text Hugo good luck the night before.

Met Imogen and Zoe for brunch. Zoe is pregnant, due in April, only told family so far. Imogen's training for the Brighton marathon, 12 April 2027. They both want to come down for a weekend in January.
Abigail says the christening for baby Rosie is 9th Nov, St Mary's, 11am, lunch at the Swan after. I'm doing the readings. Barbara (Abigail's mum) is knitting the gown.

Dafydd is properly into crosswords now, does the Times cryptic every morning on the train. Wife Noor plays chess online, rated about 1600. Thought: a nice crossword dictionary for his birthday, 28 January.
Rohan called about the cricket club dinner on 15 November. Can't make it. Need to message him tomorrow and say sorry, and offer to buy a table ticket for his dad instead.
Tendai's sister Blessing had twins on 30 September, a boy and a girl. Tendai is flying out to Harare on 6 December to meet them. He asked if I'd water his plants while he's away.
Keisha's knitting a blanket for her niece's baby, due 1 February. She's into Wordle and those Lego botanical sets too, apparently has nine. Gift hint for her: the bonsai one.

Santiago and Ximena came round. They're expecting their second in May 2027! Their eldest Mateo is starting nursery after Christmas. Santiago still plays bass in the salsa band, Fridays at the Bolivar. Should ring them next week to sort a date for dinner.
Lars has gone deep into Warhammer, painting a whole Space Marine army. His partner James is less thrilled. They've got a trip to Copenhagen 18th-22nd December to see Lars's grandparents.
Need to post Jun's book back to him. He lent me the Murakami months ago.

Ann's pregnancy has been rough, terrible morning sickness and now low iron. She's off work until 4 November at least. Her husband Jin is doing all the cooking. I should drop round some soup at the weekend and check how she's doing.

Hemi's daughter got into the regional netball squad. Trials were last Saturday, first training 2/11. Hemi's buzzing, he coached her for years. He's also into fly fishing, off to Tongariro in March 2027.
Stefan cancelled his 40th, the venue fell through. Says he'll just do drinks at the Crown on 7 November instead. He wants a new pair of running headphones, mentioned it twice.
Dalia told me she lost her grandma last week. Funeral is Thursday 23rd. She seemed really low. Must send flowers to her house before then and message her on Friday to see how she's holding up.

Big catch-up with the Nowaks. Zara is 30 weeks, baby shower on 8th of November at her mum's. Her brother Hugo is doing the cake. Her husband Oisín is building the cot himself, very proud. Zara's craving pickled onions and anything sour. I offered to drive her to the hospital tour on 12/11 since Oisín's working.
Bridget's into wild swimming now, goes every Sunday at Tooting Lido even in November. Her dog Pickle comes and sits on the side.

Phone call with Uncle Kemal. Aunt Fang's hip operation is booked for 17 January 2027 and she's anxious about it. He's taking up bowls to get out of the house. Remind me to call Fang the day before the op.
Aisha had baby Yusuf yesterday morning!! Mum and baby doing well. Aisha's husband Rohan sent photos. Get a congratulations card and that muslin set from John Lewis.
Blessing's choir is singing Messiah on 13 December at the cathedral. She's a soprano and has a small solo, very nervous. Barbara and I are going together.

Ximena mentioned she's learning to crochet, making a tiny cardigan for her friend Noor's baby, due late Feb. She also wants to start a book club in the new year. I said I'd send her my list of recommendations.
Dimitri - season ticket at Arsenal, goes to every home game with his son. Supports Olympiakos too because of his dad. Birthday 19 May.
Weekend plans: Saturday is the farmers market, Sunday I'm going to Hemi's for roast. Buy wine.

Caught up with Abigail Khan, or Abi as everyone calls her. She's six months pregnant and still playing hockey for the club's masters team, which her midwife isn't thrilled about. Their gender reveal was cancelled because her husband accidentally told everyone. Due date is 26 January 2027.
Messaged Keisha about her interview at the BBC on Monday. She said she's dreading the presentation part. Text her Monday morning to say good luck, then Tuesday to ask how it went.
Ann and Stefan are hosting a christening party for baby Elsa on Sunday 16 November, 2pm at their place. Bring something for the buffet. Ann's mum is flying in from Stockholm on the 13th.

Rohan Lewis plays tabla, has done since he was seven, and gigs with a fusion group called Monsoon Circuit. His wife Dalia is a midwife at the Royal Free. Their cat Biscuit is fourteen and has kidney problems.
Jin and his wife are trying for a baby, IVF round two starts in December. He's quite stressed about it. Didn't say much but should check in with him around Christmas.
Zoe's dad is retiring on 30 November after 35 years at the council. She's organising a surprise do at the cricket club. I'm on decorations.
Lars: plays chess at the club every Tuesday, collects vinyl, mostly 70s prog. Big Genesis fan. Doesn't drink coffee.
Dentist moved to 4 November, 9:15.

Hugo and Imogen got engaged in Lisbon last weekend! Wedding probably summer 2027, maybe July. Imogen wants a tiny ceremony. Her sister Phoebe is maid of honour. Must send them a bottle of something nice this week.
Tendai says the christening is now on 1st of March, not Feb, because his mum's visa got delayed. He's a bit fed up with it all. His son Tinashe is crawling already.

Noor rang. Her son Ali starts at the new school on 3 November, he's nervous about not knowing anyone. Noor's started a sourdough obsession, wants to send me some starter. Should ask her on the 3rd how his first day went.
Santiago's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. He's going up to Leeds on Friday. Ring him over the weekend.

Fang and her husband James are off to Japan for their tenth anniversary, 2-16 April 2027. She's planning around the cherry blossom. James is a massive Studio Ghibli fan, wants to do the museum. Ask Fang for the itinerary so I can send restaurant tips.
Quick one: Bridget's grandson was born on 10/10, called Arlo. Her daughter Zoe is doing well. Bridget is besotted. Knit something? Or buy a cardigan.

Hemi and his partner Ann are moving to Bristol on 15 December. He's got a new job at Airbus starting 5 January 2027. Ann's going to keep working remotely. Leaving drinks on 12 December at the Wheatsheaf. Their spaniel Kiri is not a fan of the car so the drive should be fun.
Talked to Dafydd about the Six Nations, he's already booked Cardiff for Wales v England, 6 March 2027. Wants me to come. Need to check flights and tell him by Friday.
Zeynep's book club is reading Middlemarch. She hates it. Her brother Kemal is doing a pottery course with her on Saturdays.
Imogen mentioned her son Leo got a grade 5 distinction on the violin. He's playing at the school concert on 4th December. She's thrilled. Send her a quick congrats message.

Phoebe's waters broke early, 35 weeks. Baby girl Maya arrived 2 November 2026 and is in special care for a few days. Phoebe is exhausted and a bit overwhelmed. Dimitri says no visitors yet. Remind me to message Phoebe on Thursday, just to see how they're both doing, and to sort a meal delivery for them.

Dalia told me about her nephew's christening in Beirut, 20th of December. She and her husband Stefan are flying out on the 18th, back on the 2nd of January. Stefan is nervous about flying. She asked me to feed their cat Za'atar while they're away.
Barbara is learning Welsh on Duolingo, 400 day streak. Her husband Dafydd is chuffed. They're celebrating their ruby anniversary on 22 March 2027 with a party at the rugby club.
Called Keisha back. She got the job! Starts 1st Dec. Her mum Blessing is throwing her a little party on Saturday. Don't forget to bring a card.
Ximena's birthday is 7/11. She's mad about Formula 1, Ferrari, has a Leclerc cap she never takes off. Would love tickets to Silverstone next July.
Kemal's wife Ann had a miscarriage last month. He told me today, quietly. They're okay but it's been hard. Need to check in with them both in a couple of weeks, gently.
Jun's daughter is doing her Grade 8 piano exam on 25 November. She's practising four hours a day. Jun says she's terrified. Jun himself has got into bouldering, goes three times a week.

Drinks with Rohan, Aisha and Lars. Rohan's training for an Ironman in Copenhagen, August 2027. Aisha just got a promotion to senior producer, starts officially on the 1st of January. Lars is moving to Oslo in February for his partner's job. Should book a farewell dinner for Lars before he goes, maybe the last weekend of January.
Need to buy a christening present for Oisín's daughter. Service is 30 November. Silver bangle? Ask Oisín's wife Jin what they've already got.

Zara rang to say she's had to cancel her baby shower, she's been put on bed rest. Due 4 January 2027. Feels really fed up. Her husband Tendai is working from home to look after her. Send her a care package with books and snacks, she loves Agatha Christie.
Hugo Bianchi (Huey) is into darts, plays in the pub league on Wednesdays. Supports Juventus. His girlfriend Zeynep is a vet.
Tidy spare room before Mum comes on the 14th.

Stefan Fischer sent a voice note from Munich. He's got tickets for Bayern v Dortmund on 28 February 2027 and has a spare, wants me or Jun to come. His brother Lars is getting baptised as an adult in the spring, which surprised everyone. Reply to Stefan by Sunday.

Blessing and her husband James renewed their vows last month in Victoria Falls. Photos are amazing. She's now planning a surprise party for his 50th on 5 April 2027. Asked me to help find a band. Should email Stefan about his jazz trio.

Long walk with Noor and Dimitri. Noor's due on 12 December, it's their first. Dimitri's built a playlist for the labour room, very him. Noor's mum is moving in for the first six weeks. They want to name him Idris if it's a boy. Noor admitted she's terrified of the birth. I said I'd come round on the weekend of 29 November to help them put the pram together.
Abigail and her wife Imogen adopted a kitten called Moth. Imogen is back at work after maternity leave from next Monday, the 27th. Their baby Rosa is nearly a year, first birthday 14 December.
